latest_release.body:
Upgrading

Before upgrading refer to the migration guide for a complete list of changes.

All resolved issues

Security fixes

  • #53061 [CVE-2026-92358] Cross-browser fallback proof survives successful account linking and self-service unlink organizations
  • #53618 [CVE-2026-105305] Device Authorization Grant bypasses per-client minimum.acr.value enforcement authentication
  • #53749 CVE-2026-107623: OIDC DCR read-modify-write silently disables offline token revocation on backchannel logout oidc
  • #53813 [CVE-2026-107889] Stored XSS on the login page via kcSanitize bypass authentication
  • #54333 [CVE-2026-111497] Out-of-bounds write in bundled Brotli decoder dist/quarkus
  • #54687 [CVE-2026-112201] Login-failure upsert trusts MySQL/MariaDB affected-row count
  • #54688 [CVE-2026-112208] Account takeover via stale SSO_AUTH note in Organization identity-first login (reproduced on 26.8.1)
  • #54689 [CVE-2026-110932] Keycloak <= 26.8.0 : Unauthenticated persistent disk exhaustion (theme gzip cache)
  • #54690 [CVE-2026-107123] Unauthenticated DoS in Keycloak SAML endpoint
  • #54691 [CVE-2026-107124] Session takeover by victim logout with injected id_token_hint
  • #54692 [CVE-2026-107602] Unauthenticated CPU and worker-pool exhaustion (restart required) via SAML 1.1 KeyInfo parser loop on a legal ds:KeyName
  • #54693 [CVE-2026-110931] Unauthenticated single-request JVM termination (OutOfMemoryError) via SAML 1.1 AuthorityBinding parser loop, incomplete fix of CVE-2026-7307
  • #54694 [CVE-2026-97367] DCR azp+sid claim substitution via User Property mappers allows Account REST victim session takeover — #YWH-PGM40475-313
  • #54695 [CVE-2026-97174] CIBA sub parameter injection causes attacker authentication to issue victim tokens — #YWH-PGM40475-289
  • #54696 [CVE-2026-114232] UMA user-managed permission resourceType field not validated — cross-owner resource access — #YWH-PGM40475-306
  • #54697 [CVE-2026-97847] Client manager can replace a sessionless token principal and take over the realm — #YWH-PGM40475-292
  • #54698 [CVE-2026-96547] DCR registration-time claim-path gap: attribute mappers forge realm_access.roles from user-editable fields
  • #54699 [CVE-2026-96457] Group-admin DENY bypass via top-level move (GroupsResource, CVE-2026-9099 regression)
  • #54700 [CVE-2026-96460] Token from token exchange can have unlimited expiration
  • #54701 [CVE-2026-97848] [SE

# Open Source Identity and Access Management

Add authentication to applications and secure services with minimum effort. No need to deal with storing users or authenticating users.

Keycloak provides user federation, strong authentication, user management, fine-grained authorization, and more.


## Help and Documentation

* [Documentation](https://www.keycloak.org/documentation.html)
* [User Mailing List](https://groups.google.com/d/forum/keycloak-user) - Mailing list for help and general questions about Keycloak
* Join [#keycloak](https://cloud-native.slack.com/archives/C056HC17KK9) for general questions, or [#keycloak-dev](https://cloud-native.slack.com/archives/C056XU905S6) on Slack for design and development discussions, by creating an account at [https://slack.cncf.io/](https://slack.cncf.io/).


## Reporting Security Vulnerabilities

If you have found a security vulnerability, please look at the [instructions on how to properly report it](https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/security/policy).


## Reporting an issue

If you believe you have discovered a defect in Keycloak, please open [an issue](https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak/issues).
Please remember to provide a good summary, description as well as steps to reproduce the issue.


## Getting started

To run Keycloak, download the distribution from our [website](https://www.keycloak.org/downloads.html). Unzip and run:

    bin/kc.[sh|bat] start-dev

Alternatively, you can use the Docker image by running:

    docker run quay.io/keycloak/keycloak start-dev
    
For more details refer to the [Keycloak Documentation](https://www.keycloak.org/documentation.html).


## Building from Source

To build from source, refer to the [building and working with the code base](docs/building.md) guide.


### Testing

To run tests, refer to the [running tests](docs/tests.md) guide.
